result.summary: Decoded 29209 packets across 38 IP endpoints and 203 transport flows. Observed 140 DNS events, 241 HTTP requests, 23 TLS ClientHello events, and 500 recovered file/message object(s). Deterministic rules produced 40 finding(s): 4 high, 32 medium, and 4 low. Findings are evidence-bound candidates and require analyst review; encrypted payload contents remain unavailable.

warnings: Conflicting TCP overlap: fallback extraction rejected this direction
limitations: Encrypted application contents are not decrypted
Protocol decoding and heuristic findings do not establish malware family or attribution
No endpoint execution, persistence, or credential-theft proof without corresponding evidence

http_objects.selection: content-classified first, then size descending, SHA256 tie-break; deduplicated by full hash; overflow retains a compact hash index

supplemental_objects.scope: bounded IMF, inert embedded base64 and complete contiguous HTTP response recovery
